card.name: Stopping bleeding after needle or surgery
card.fires_on: Linking words, commas and word starts right before an expected 'apply pressure' or 'hemostasis' step, mostly after injections, needle removal or surgery.

modes.label: Pressure on injection site
modes.description: Small words after a bleed or needle removal, just before 'apply pressure' or gauze instructions.
modes.example: If any bleeding occurs<<,>> apply gentle pressure.

modes.label: Hemostasis wording
modes.description: The start of 'hemostasis' after 'once', 'after' or 'achieve' in surgical dosing text.
modes.example: once daily after<< hem>>ostasis has been established.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like 'press' and 'bleeding' and away from 'recovery' words.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say to press on a site or that bleeding has been controlled.
